about: Discover training: Noah's verdicts on what SOCIA suggested, used to write the rules in lib/discoverRules.ts. Add a round each time a brand's suggestions are reviewed.

rounds.verdict: none of these are good since this is an app i have to look for other apps that is kinda similar to or posts similar videos (animated videos that i can copy for myself)
rounds.rule: A business competes with businesses of its own kind: for an app, other apps and software products, preferring ones whose Reels are animated product videos. Coaches, educators, agencies and influencers are wrong for a business.
rounds.earlier: 2026-11-15: an NFL commentator (Clark Gary) appeared in Socia's From your niche Reels because only the video style matched (fixed in PR #336).

good.for: SOCIA (an AI app for Instagram growth; own videos animated)
good.noah: look at this account this is a good one
good.what: Founder account (Jayant, verified, 42.2K followers, 452 posts) for the app ootto.ai, bio 'AI for Instagram growth'. Not a brand account: the founder markets his own app.
good.videos: Animated explainers with app UI cards and steps ('Research first. Then the Reels.', 'Connect Claude to your Instagram', 'How to edit video with Claude'), word-by-word captions, a pixel-art mascot; some talking to camera.
good.why_good: Same kind of product (an AI app for Instagram growth that also connects Claude), selling to the same customers, with animated product videos SOCIA can copy.
good.lesson: An app's competitor often posts from its founder's personal account, not a brand account. It counts when the account sells or shows its own app (a link to the app, the app's screens in the videos); a coach selling courses or tips does not.

good.for: SOCIA (an AI app for Instagram growth; own videos animated)
good.what: Creator and educator (Nick Saraev, verified, 743K followers; 'Founder @ Maker School', a paid community teaching beginners to land AI clients). Not an app.
good.videos: Talking head with animated app screens over it (a Claude Code timeline, tool windows), word-by-word captions; covers are logos of AI tools (Claude, Grok, Meta AI, GitHub) around his face with a bold red title.
good.why_good: His videos are about AI tools and apps and show them in action with animated UI overlays: the format SOCIA can copy, for an audience interested in AI tools.
good.lesson: Not every good account is an app. A creator also counts when the videos show apps or AI tools in action (screens, animated UI demos). The round-1 coaches failed because they gave general marketing tips with no product on screen, not because they were people.

two_lists.noah: those can be my competitors but for example for reels in my niche or i can copy could be viral animated reels
two_lists.competitors: Apps in the same space (AI and social media tools), including a founder's account that sells its app. Accepted: vidiq, metricool, predis.ai, opusclip, flick.social, jayantcreates.ai (ootto.ai).
two_lists.reels_to_copy: Not only competitors' Reels: Reels from the niche, and viral animated Reels whose format SOCIA can copy (like nick_saraev's animated app overlays). A creator who isn't a competitor can still be a source of Reels to copy.
